title: Erdős' theorem on graphs of large girth and large chromatic number
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of Erdős' 1959 theorem: for every g and k there is a finite graph with girth greater than g and chromatic number greater than k. The formalization proves the structural form given by Erdős' probabilistic argument: for every g and every ε > 0, for all sufficiently large n there is a graph on n vertices with no cycle of length at most g in which every independent set has fewer than εn vertices; hence, for all large n, a graph on n vertices with girth greater than g that is not k-colourable. Mathlib has girth and chromatic number but not this theorem; Mycielski's construction (registered separately by another author) gives triangle-free graphs only.
